description: Rb₂NaAl₃F₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.09 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.22 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-65°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.38 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-65°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.87 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-56°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.87 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.87 Å. There are eight inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Al atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two equivalent Al atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Rb, one Na, and one Al atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Al atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Al atom.
